name: The house of Charetty
head: Marian de Charetty
blurb: Dyers, couriers and the employers of Astorre's company. A widow's business that the whole of Bruges underestimates, which is exactly how she likes it.

contracts.title: The London letters
contracts.brief: A satchel of letters for the Lombard Street bankers, and three sacks of English wool on the way back.

contracts.title: Clear the Sluys road
contracts.brief: The dockside bullies at Sluys have been taxing the Charetty barges. Remind them whose barges they are.

contracts.title: Scarlet for the vats
contracts.brief: A Flemish lord wants scarlet for a wedding, and he wants it by Sunday. Two pots of Geneva kermes.

contracts.title: Drill the lances
contracts.brief: Astorre's company is idle between wars and idleness costs money. Put in the hours alongside them.

name: The Medici bank
head: Tommaso Portinari
blurb: The Bruges branch of the greatest bank in Christendom, run by a man who lends to dukes against the advice of Florence. Membership is a seat at the green baize.

contracts.title: Letters for the Via Larga
contracts.brief: Sealed letters for Cosimo's own counting house. Nobody opens them, nobody is late with them.

contracts.title: Read the Genoese post
contracts.brief: The Doria write to their Bruges factor in cipher. Portinari would like to know what they say.

contracts.title: Gold for the exchange
contracts.brief: The exchange at Bruges is short of specie. Two pouches of gold dust from beyond the desert would ease it considerably.

contracts.title: Capital for the branch
contracts.brief: Portinari has lent the Duke more than Florence knows. Put money into the branch, quietly.

name: St Pol and Ribérac
head: Jordan de Ribérac
blurb: The vicomte de Ribérac's household and his son Simon's: Scottish lands, French titles, and a talent for violence that passes in their circle for honour. They reward those who are useful, and only for as long as they are.

contracts.title: Teach the street manners
contracts.brief: Simon has been laughed at in the Waterhalle. Find three people to make an example of.

contracts.title: The Damme toll
contracts.brief: The vicomte's barges pay no tolls. See that they continue not to.

contracts.title: Fit to serve
contracts.brief: Jordan de Ribérac does not keep soft men. Two hundred points in the yards, and he will look at you twice.

contracts.title: Astorre's men
contracts.brief: The Charetty's mercenaries have grown proud. Beat Thomas, Astorre's lieutenant, before the day is out.

name: The Doria company
head: Pagano Doria
blurb: Genoese shipowners with a galley in every harbour and a smile for every customs officer. Pagano Doria trades in anything, including people's trust.

contracts.title: Sugar from Kouklia
contracts.brief: The Lusignan cane fields are selling cheap while Cyprus has two kings. Two loaves, before the price recovers.

contracts.title: A second set of papers
contracts.brief: A Florentine galley is in port with more silk than its papers admit to. Pagano would like the difference.

contracts.title: Embarrass the Medici
contracts.brief: Portinari's couriers carry more than letters. Win two fights in the street and the Medici look careless.

contracts.title: The last Greek empire
contracts.brief: Trebizond is falling to the Turk and selling everything on its way down. Three bolts of silk from the last market in the empire.
